title: Crisp plaice on toast with dill cucumber

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a whole, everyday food: fish, yoghurt, bread, butter, flour, vinegar, cucumber, watercress and herbs.

supermarket.reason: Plaice fillets, watercress, Greek yoghurt and the rest are on the shelves at Tesco at normal prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a frying pan, a bowl, a grater for the zest and a toaster or grill, all used in simple techniques.

works.reason: Four thin plaice fillets fried briefly, a whole quick-pickled cucumber and dill yoghurt on four slices of toast makes a balanced, well-seasoned lunch for four.

honest_times.reason: Slicing, chopping dill, zesting and toasting fit in 20 minutes, and the cucumber's 10-minute rest is unattended, as is the short frying.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed item, including the dill, lemon, salt and pepper, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A whole quick-pickled cucumber with dill is a main component of a light May lunch, not a garnish, and suits the season.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English that a neighbour would follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Fish, wholemeal toast, yoghurt and fresh greens make a proper, appealing lunch.
